title: Head of Department (HOD) Endorsement & Departmental Review of Student Leave Petitions

steps.title: Faculty Advisor Portal Authentication
steps.description: Faculty Advisor / HOD (Dr. Rajesh Sharma) authenticates to CampXSync with authorized R32/R10 staff session

steps.title: Navigate to Faculty Advisory & Advisees Desk
steps.description: Verify Faculty Advisory workspace loads with assigned departmental advisee monitoring authority

steps.title: Inspect Assigned Student Advisee Roster
steps.description: System displays active advisees assigned to this faculty member by institutional registry

steps.title: Inspect Pending Advisee Petitions Queue
steps.description: System renders pending leave and transfer petitions submitted by advisees awaiting departmental clearance

steps.title: Locate Advisee Medical Leave Petition
steps.description: Faculty advisor identifies pending orthopedic recovery leave petition submitted by advisee

steps.title: Trigger Departmental Endorsement Action
steps.description: Faculty advisor opens departmental review and recommendation modal for the petition

steps.title: Verify Endorsement Modal Displayed
steps.description: Departmental Endorsement modal opens with recommendation options and mandatory remarks input

steps.title: Select Recommendation Level
steps.description: Faculty selects RECOMMENDED endorsement based on fulfilled departmental criteria

steps.title: Enter Departmental Review Remarks
steps.description: Faculty advisor inputs detailed justification (> 5 chars) confirming academic progress clearance
steps.value: HOD and Faculty Advisor review completed. Student satisfies departmental attendance and academic progress thresholds for orthopedic medical leave.

steps.title: Submit Departmental Endorsement
steps.description: Faculty submits formal endorsement to Java Lifecycle Service via API Gateway, appending immutable history entry

steps.title: Verify Endorsement Confirmation
steps.description: System displays success banner confirming petition was endorsed and forwarded to Registrar Lifecycle Review Desk

steps.title: Verify Departmental Endorsement Badge on Faculty Desk
steps.description: Pending advisee petitions table renders updated endorsement status badge

steps.title: Registrar Desk Verification — College Admin Sign-In
steps.description: College Administrator / Registrar authenticates to review endorsed petition on institutional desk

steps.title: Verify HOD Endorsement Surfaced to Registrar
steps.description: Registrar Pending Requests queue renders HOD Endorsement badge and remarks on the petition row

steps.title: PostgreSQL Immutable Endorsement History Check
steps.description: Read-only query verifies stu.lifecycle_history contains committed hod.endorsement row in Supabase PostgreSQL
steps.query: SELECT count(*) AS endorsement_count FROM stu.lifecycle_history WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND student_id = '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a6764861f924' AND action LIKE 'hod.endorsement:RECOMMENDED%'

steps.title: Negative RBAC Check — Gateway Direct Unauthenticated Access Blocked
steps.description: Gateway strictly blocks unauthenticated requests to /api/v1/lifecycle/advisor/requests with HTTP 401 Unauthorized
